Gaurs Group Buys Land Near Yamuna Expressway for ₹700 Crore

Gaurs Group has purchased two land parcels totaling 35 acres along the Yamuna Expressway. The seller was ICICI Bank, and the transaction was valued at approximately ₹700 crore. The deal was reported by multiple outlets.
